relations.meaning: The product is guided by its Product Thesis without the thesis proving product realization.
Registry Context resolution is a CyberAlchemy product capability, not a separate product.
The Project durably coordinates this Goal without achieving it by membership.
The Project has an explicit CAV2-D66 Context for this construction scope.
The first vertical tests one bounded product-thesis realization and cannot prove the whole thesis.
Registry Context specializes canonical CAV2-D66 Context with registered exact selections and read-only resolution; it does not redefine Context.
The capability accepts one bounded Request.
Successful resolution produces one immutable View; failure produces no resolved View.
The capability fails closed under the integrity policy.
The local resolver is one prototype realization, not the capability identity.
The prototype is checked against the compiled DomainSpec development graph.
v2 replaces the active package contract while preserving v1 as non-active compatibility evidence.
The first vertical's Goal Context is the first registered instance used to exercise the Registry Context specialization.
